lines.en: label dormwartwo9:
scene clearnightsky
It’s cold again, though I’m not sure why.
lines.zh: 又冷起来了，尽管我不知道为什么。

lines.en: Less than twelve hours ago, around the time I was enveloped in the flesh of a girl whose name just found her way onto paper, the fabric of my shirt stuck to my skin from sweat brought on by the summer sun.
lines.zh: 不到十二个小时之前，大约在我被一个女孩的肉体包裹着的时候——那个女孩的名字刚刚才落到纸上——我衬衫的布料还因为夏日阳光催出的汗水黏在皮肤上。

lines.en: The sun is dead now. And the moon is simply too small and too dormant to bleed the same heat its older brother does.
lines.zh: 太阳现在死了。而月亮又太小、太沉眠，流不出它哥哥那样的热度。

lines.en: Ayane is gone, though she won’t be joining Noriko at the hotel.
lines.zh: Ayane 走了，不过她不会去酒店和 Noriko 一起。

lines.en: Instead, she’s headed home to ponder over a tangible list of my misdeeds that aren’t {i}really{/i} misdeeds because I never promised myself to any one person in the first place.
lines.zh: 相反，她回家去了，去对着一张实实在在的名单发呆——那上面写着我的种种劣迹，可那些其实算不上劣迹，因为说{i}到底{/i}我从来没有把自己许诺给任何一个人。

lines.en: Which makes the feelings I’m feeling right now feel a lot more confusing.
lines.zh: 这也让我此刻的感受变得更加混乱。

lines.en: : Yeah?
: {i}Sensei! What in the world is taking you so long? We’re all waiting for you, you know!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}老师！你到底在磨蹭什么？我们都在等你呢，你知道吗！{/i}

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 对哦……

lines.en: : Where am I supposed to go again?
lines.zh: : 我要去哪儿来着？

lines.en: : {i}Home! For the Midnight Mom Mosh. Even though it’s getting closer to 1:00 AM now, which makes the name feel kind of pointless.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}回家啊！参加午夜妈妈大乱斗。虽然现在都快凌晨一点了，搞得这个名字有点没意义了。{/i}

lines.en: : Okay...I’ll be there soon. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 好……我马上到。抱歉。

lines.en: : {i}You don’t have to apologize. I know you were doing stuff with Ayane. Just get here as fast as you can, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你不用道歉。我知道你在和 Ayane 做些事。你尽快过来就好，行吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I love-{/i}
scene black
I hang up the phone and fill in the rest of her sentence with words she’d never say.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，用她永远不会说出口的话，把那句话剩下的部分补完。

lines.en: Hearing the truth would just make this walk ten times longer...and the weight of a fulfilled promise ten times heavier.
lines.zh: 听到真相只会让这段路变得长十倍……让一个已经兑现的承诺的重量也重上十倍。

lines.en: I wouldn’t be able to handle that when I’m already being crushed beneath its weight.
lines.zh: 我已经被它的重量压得喘不过气了，再也承受不起这些。

lines.en: scene momwar1
How can I be expected to carry on like everything is normal?
lines.zh: 他们怎么能指望我像什么都没发生过一样继续下去？

lines.en: How am I supposed to enjoy participating in this ridiculous contest when I know that the girl who won just a short while ago is bawling her eyes out on her bedroom floor because of me?
lines.zh: 当我知道，刚刚才赢下比赛的那女孩正因为我在她卧室的地板上哭得撕心裂肺时，我怎么可能还有心情享受这场荒唐的比赛？

lines.en: There were too many names on the list. I should have marked down less.
lines.zh: 那张名单上的名字太多了。我本该少写几个。

lines.en: I should have kept the one signature in ink as the only one on the page and thrown myself into a lie that we could hide behind until we’re sent back to the beginning.
lines.zh: 我本该让那一个用墨水签下的名字成为纸上唯一的名字，然后把自己扔进一个我们可以躲在后面的谎言里，直到我们被送回起点。

lines.en: Maybe then, she’ll be able to fall for a version of me that won’t neglect her the way I do.
lines.zh: 也许那样，她就能爱上一个不会像我这样冷落她的我。

lines.en: Maybe then, she’ll be able to live a life devoid of rooftops and resets and just enjoy her time in this endless cycle.
lines.zh: 也许那样，她就能过上没有天台、没有重置的生活，只是享受她在这个无尽循环里的时光。

lines.en: Blissfully ignorant.
lines.zh: 幸福地无知着。

lines.en: Happily unaware.
lines.zh: 快乐地毫不知情。

lines.en: I thought up a poem on the way home.
lines.zh: 回家的路上，我想了一首诗。

lines.en: It goes something like this.
lines.zh: 大概是这样的。

lines.en: Roses are red.
lines.zh: 玫瑰是红的。

lines.en: Violets are pretty.
lines.zh: 紫罗兰很漂亮。

lines.en: I wonder what life’s like outside of this city.
lines.zh: 我很好奇，这座城市之外的生活是什么样子。

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师。

lines.en: scene happy3
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene momwar2
I’m fine now.
lines.zh: 我现在没事了。

lines.en: Not because I’m over it.
lines.zh: 不是因为我已经放下了。

lines.en: But because I have to be.
lines.zh: 而是因为我必须如此。

lines.en: Or I will hurt everyone else inside of this room.
lines.zh: 否则我就会伤到这个房间里的其他人。

lines.en: And keep them locked in the attic to use whenever I see fit.
lines.zh: 然后把她们锁在阁楼里，等我觉得合适的时候再拿出来用。

lines.en: scene momwar1
But that’s okay because now I’ve got dramatic action music to lighten the mood.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为现在我有激昂的动作片配乐来缓和气氛了。

lines.en: Time for mom stuff.
lines.zh: 到了妈妈的时间了。

lines.en: : There are too many women in this house.
lines.zh: : 这屋子里女人太多了。

lines.en: : Correction. There are {i}two{/i} women and a bunch of young girls.
lines.zh: : 更正一下。是{i}两个{/i}女人和一群年轻女孩。

lines.en: If they were {b}all{/b} women, MY BONER WOULDN’T BE THIS BIG! HAHAHA!
lines.zh: 如果她们{b}全都{/b}是女人，我的老二才不会硬成这样！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Whatever they are, it feels wrong. But I can’t even do anything about it because turning down the generous donation from the Produce Delivery Administration would be a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 不管她们算什么，这感觉都不对劲。可我甚至什么都做不了，因为拒绝农产品配送管理局那笔慷慨的捐款，会是个坏主意。

lines.en: : Well, don’t look at me all angry.
lines.zh: : 那你就别气鼓鼓地看着我。

lines.en: : But I have nowhere else to direct my rage since I have to be a good host.
lines.zh: : 可是我得做个好主人，我的怒火没别的地方可以发泄。

lines.en: : That is your problem, not mine.
lines.zh: : 那是你的问题，不是我的。

lines.en: : Uhh...hi. I’m sorry for speaking out of turn, but I was worried there wouldn’t be another opportunity to say that and it would be weird if I was just here and...not saying anything at all.
lines.zh: : 呃……你好。抱歉我插嘴了，不过我担心以后没机会说这句话，而我就这么待在这儿……却一句话都不说，会很奇怪。

lines.en: : Hey, Io. I still have your video game if you want it back.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Io。你的电子游戏还在我这儿，想要回去的话随时说。

lines.en: : Why do you have Io’s-
lines.zh: : 你为什么会有 Io 的——

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...Why don’t you keep it? For the next time I decide to stop by.
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……不如你留着吧？留着下次我决定顺路过来的时候玩。

lines.en: scene momwar3
: {i}Next{/i} time?
: That’s right. I went in your room and everything.
lines.zh: : 没错。我还进过你的房间呢，什么都干了。

lines.en: : You {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Like a panther stalking her prey...or a viper waiting to strike...Io Ichimonji is never detected before it’s already too late.
lines.zh: : 像美洲豹潜行逼近猎物……又像毒蛇伺机而动……Io Ichimonji 从来不会被人察觉，等察觉到时已经太迟了。

lines.en: : You should probably take a page out of her book then, since taking up an attack pose in my kitchen makes you seem like a pretty lousy kunoichi.
lines.zh: : 那你大概该跟她学学，因为在我的厨房里摆出一副进攻姿态，会让你看起来像个相当蹩脚的女忍者。

lines.en: : Or could it be...you’re just an easy target?
lines.zh: : 或者……会不会只是你太好对付了？

lines.en: : Well, it wouldn’t be the first time you’ve taken me down, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你把我放倒也不是第一次了，如果你懂我意思的话。

lines.en: scene momwar4
: I don’t. Please explain, dearest uncle.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。请解释一下，亲爱的叔叔。

lines.en: : Me neither. Please explain, dearest Uta.
lines.zh: : 我也不懂。请解释一下，亲爱的 Uta。

lines.en: scene momwar5
: Wshhhhh!
: Or just hide behind him, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆躲到他身后去，我看是。

lines.en: : Sensei. Please make your way to the living room so we can get this over with. I’d like to have a few words with our non-adult guests.
lines.zh: : 老师。请到客厅去，我们好把事情办完。我想和我们的未成年来宾说几句话。

lines.en: scene black
: Sure. Just don’t get any blood on the floor. It’ll stain the wood.
lines.zh: : 好啊。只是别把血弄到地板上。会渗进木头里的。

lines.en: : I mean, that really depends on the type of wood. This looks like-
lines.zh: : 我是说，那其实得看是什么木头。这个看起来像是——

lines.en: : It will stain.
lines.zh: : 会渗进去的。

lines.en: : {i}I know it will.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我知道会。{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene momwar6
: Hey, everybody. Sorry for the wait. I had to ruin someone’s life.
lines.zh: : 嘿，各位。抱歉让你们久等了。我刚不得不去毁掉一个人的人生。

lines.en: : All in a day’s work, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想，那不过是日常工作的一部分。

lines.en: : See? Makoto knows how it is.
lines.zh: : 看吧？Makoto 懂的。

lines.en: : No worries at all! And, let me just say, I absolutely {i}love{/i} what you’ve done with your shed.
lines.zh: : 完全不用在意！而且我得说，你把这个小屋布置得我真是太{i}喜欢{/i}了。

lines.en: : This is my house.
lines.zh: : 这是我的房子。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. I’m not nearly as gullible as my daughter. I won’t fall for such an obvious prank.
lines.zh: : 哦，别逗了。我可没我女儿那么好骗。这种显而易见的玩笑我可不上当。

lines.en: : Well, you’re certainly just as humble as her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你倒确实和她一样谦逊。

lines.en: : This is my first time ever staying up this late! And it would be quite exhilarating if not for the fact that this dress has been nearly suffocating me for hours now!
lines.zh: : 这可是我有生以来第一次熬到这么晚！要不是这条裙子已经把我闷得快窒息好几个小时了，我肯定会相当兴奋的！

lines.en: : Grin and bear it, dear. This is what it means to be a lady.
lines.zh: : 咬牙忍着吧，亲爱的。这就是做淑女的代价。

lines.en: : Yes, Mother. You always know best.
lines.zh: : 是，母亲。您总是对的。

lines.en: : Yo! I didn’t bring my briefcase this time. But I’ve got a whole bunch of other tricks up my sleeve that’ll help me take down Tsubasa here.
lines.zh: : 哟！这次我没带公文包。不过我袖子里还藏着一大堆别的招数，足以帮我干掉这位 Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene momwar7
: I would have worn sleeves as well if I had known we were allowed to hide useful items in them. Up until now, I was under the assumption we would be fighting fairly.
lines.zh: : 如果早知道允许把有用的东西藏在袖子里，我也会穿长袖的。直到现在，我还以为我们会公平对决呢。

lines.en: : Why did I decide to tag along for this again? Can someone remind me?
lines.zh: : 我当初到底是为什么决定要跟来的？谁能提醒我一下？

lines.en: : Because you’re your mother’s official representative and not being here would have disqualified you!
lines.zh: : 因为你是你母亲的正式代表，不来就会被取消资格！

lines.en: scene momwar8
: Where the hell did you come from?
lines.zh: : 你到底是从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: : Oh, you know me. Probably blended in with your curtains or something.
lines.zh: : 哦，你了解我的。大概是和你的窗帘融为一体之类的吧。

lines.en: : Being disqualified sounds like a dignified way to lose. Let’s do that, Mom.
lines.zh: : 被取消资格听起来是一种体面的输法。我们就这么办吧，妈妈。

lines.en: : More dignified than being {i}true{/i} Miyamuras and getting our asses pounded? No way.
lines.zh: : 比做个{i}真正{/i}的 Miyamura 家的人、把屁股打开花更体面？不可能。

lines.en: : Please don’t equate our surname to the act of “ass-pounding.” At least half of us that remain are decently civilized.
lines.zh: : 请不要把我们的姓氏和「打屁股」这种行为画上等号。至少我们剩下的人里有一半还是相当文明的。

lines.en: : Which means that the other half of us are versatile and ready to take it in any hole at any time so long as the mood is right!
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我们另一半人多才多艺，只要气氛到位，随时愿意在任何洞里接下任何东西！

lines.en: : Oh, will we be golfing? Should I contact my caddy?
lines.zh: : 哦，我们是要打高尔夫吗？我要不要联系一下我的球童？

lines.en: : We will {i}not{/i} be golfing! But I will be exercising my role as judge to award Tsubasa an extra ten points for being adorable and aloof!
lines.zh: : 我们{i}不{/i}打高尔夫！不过我要行使我作为裁判的职权，给 Tsubasa 额外加十分，理由是她既可爱又高冷！

lines.en: : Oh, yay! We’re winning!
lines.zh: : 哦，耶！我们赢啦！

lines.en: : And then Maki an extra ten points for being way braver than I could ever be.
lines.zh: : 然后再给 Maki 额外加十分，理由是她比我勇敢太多了。

lines.en: : Oh, shoot. We’re no longer winning.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。我们又不赢了。

lines.en: : Makoto! That’s ten more points than you said I was going to score tonight! Are you proud of me yet?!
lines.zh: : Makoto！这比你说的我今晚能拿到的分数多了十分！你现在为我骄傲了吗？！

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。

lines.en: : I’m proud of you, Mrs. Miyamura! It takes a great deal of skill to tie my mother in anything and I believe you will be a worthy adversary for our competition tonight.
lines.zh: : 我为你骄傲，Miyamura 夫人！能在任何事情上和我母亲打成平手都需要极高的技巧，我相信您会是今晚比赛里一位配得上我的对手。

lines.en: : Please don’t encourage her.
lines.zh: : 请不要鼓励她。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Everybody shut up.
lines.zh: : 好了，好了。所有人都闭嘴。

lines.en: : We’re all tired as Hell, so I’m going to explain the rules of this contest now so we can breeze straight through it before going home and getting some sleep.
lines.zh: : 我们都累得要死了，所以我现在就把比赛规则讲一遍，好让我们直接顺顺利利地过完，然后回家睡觉。

lines.en: : Maki and Tsubasa will compete in a series of three tests to determine which one of them is more stereotypically {i}motherly.{/i}
lines.zh: : Maki 和 Tsubasa 将进行三项测试，来决定她们谁更符合刻板印象里的{i}母亲形象{/i}。

lines.en: : The first test will be simple. The two of you will cook a signature dish for Sensei- who will be roleplaying as your son.
lines.zh: : 第一项测试很简单。你们两个要为老师做一道拿手菜——老师将扮演你们的儿子。

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : You don’t have a say in the matter. You’re the only one here with a dick.
lines.zh: : 这事你没有发言权。这儿唯一有老二的就是你。

lines.en: : Attached to him, sure. But I’ve got at least ten rubber ones in the trunk of my car that beg to differ!
lines.zh: : 长在他身上，那是没错。但我车后备箱里至少有十个橡胶的，它们可不同意这话！

lines.en: : Fucking Christ, Mom. Please.
lines.zh: : 我操，妈。拜托。

lines.en: : The second and third competitions will be revealed when we get to them. But it’s important to note that these competitions will {i}also{/i} relate to the standard duties of the average mother.
lines.zh: : 第二项和第三项比赛到时再公布。不过有一点很重要——这两项比赛{i}同样{/i}和普通母亲的日常职责有关。

lines.en: : The subjects in these rounds have been chosen by the mothers’ daughters as their “areas of expertise” so, should an unexpected winner emerge from either of these rounds, we’ll {i}likely{/i} have a full-on winner.
lines.zh: : 这两轮的题目是由母亲们的女儿选出来的，作为她们的「专长领域」。所以一旦这两轮里出现意料之外的赢家，我们{i}大概{/i}就有了全场赢家。

lines.en: : Does anyone have any questions? Or are we ready to get this show on the road?
lines.zh: : 有人有问题吗？还是说我们准备好开始了？

lines.en: : I have a question for Maki. Is that allowed?
lines.zh: : 我有个问题想问 Maki。可以吗？

lines.en: scene momwar9
: I mean...I guess? So long as you’re not trying to sabotage her strategy or anything.
lines.zh: : 我是说……大概可以吧？只要你不是想破坏她的策略什么的。

lines.en: : Of course not. I simply wish to know why she has so many rubber penises in the trunk of her car.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我只是想知道，为什么她车后备箱里有那么多橡胶阴茎。

lines.en: : Mother! You shouldn’t say “rubber penis” in public! It’s uncouth!
lines.zh: : 母亲！您不该在公共场合说「橡胶阴茎」！太失礼了！

lines.en: : I know, dear. {i}But that’s just so many of them.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道，亲爱的。{i}可那数量也实在太多了。{/i}

lines.en: : Now that you mention it, I am also curious. Ten seems excessive.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，我也挺好奇的。十个似乎太多了。

lines.en: : Permission to pause the contest for several hours while I explain the exact needs for at least ten rubber penises at all times?
lines.zh: : 我可以申请暂停比赛几个小时，来解释一下为什么随时都需要至少十个橡胶阴茎吗？

lines.en: : Permission denied. Round one starts now.
lines.zh: : 申请驳回。第一轮现在开始。

lines.en: scene black
: Ladies! Positions!
lines.zh: : 女士们！各就各位！

lines.en: : How do you want me? Doggy? Missionary? Or are we just going to do this standing up?
lines.zh: : 你想让我怎么来？后入？传教士？还是我们就站着来？

lines.en: : Oh my. Is such a thing possible?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。那样也行吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but only if the heights work well together. It gets really weird when-
lines.zh: : 行啊，只要身高搭得合适就行。不然会很怪，尤其当——

lines.en: : In the kitchen, damn it!
lines.zh: : 是在厨房里，妈的！

lines.en: : Jeez, fine. But I’m checking if the stove is on first because I am not making that same mistake a fourth time.
lines.zh: : 天哪，好吧。不过我得先确认灶台有没有开，因为我可不想第四次犯同样的错。

lines.en: : Ugh...
scene momwar10
: Okay, girls! The PDA has provided every ingredient you’d ever need to cook a nice Japanese comfort dish!
lines.zh: : 好了，姑娘们！农产品配送管理局提供了你们做一道美味日式家常菜所能用到的每一种食材！

lines.en: : You’ve got thirty minutes to both prep and finish your dish, and the person who will rank them is none other than your son, Sensei! Who...also happens to be in the kitchen for some reason.
lines.zh: : 你们有三十分钟来准备并完成菜品，而负责打分的人不是别人，正是你们的儿子——老师！而他……不知为何也正好在厨房里。

lines.en: : I’m worried Maki is going to break something.
lines.zh: : 我担心 Maki 会把什么东西弄坏。

lines.en: : I am also worried about that. I can’t even remember the last time I actually tried cooking anything.
lines.zh: : 我也在担心这个。我甚至都记不清上一次真正下厨是什么时候了。

lines.en: : It has been quite a while for me as well, but I’m sure that I can remember {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我也是很久没做了，不过我相信我还想得起{i}点什么{/i}。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Mother. If there is anything I know about you, it’s that you’re capable of doing anything you set your mind to!
lines.zh: : 别担心，母亲。要说我了解您什么，那就是只要您下定决心，就没有做不到的事！

lines.en: : How come my daughter isn’t ever that unconditionally supportive?
lines.zh: : 为什么我女儿从来不会这样无条件地支持我？

lines.en: : She was of your husband, wasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她曾经对你丈夫是这样的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but unless you’ve got a time machine in your vegetable crisper, I doubt that will come in handy right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过除非你的蔬菜保鲜抽屉里有台时光机，我怀疑那现在帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : That’s it! No more talking! Get cooking or you both lose!
lines.zh: : 够了！不许再说话！去做菜，不然你们两个都输！

lines.en: scene black
Tsubasa quickly begins sifting through all of the bags and searching for whatever ingredients she needs for her dish while Maki...
lines.zh: Tsubasa 迅速开始翻检所有的袋子，寻找她那道菜需要的食材，而 Maki……

lines.en: Uhh...
: Woah. What the fuck is this thing?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。这玩意儿到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: : Oh! That would be a geoduck. It’s a type of Pacific clam that’s often used in fine dining and-
lines.zh: : 哦！那是象拔蚌。是一种太平洋产的蛤类，经常用在高级料理里，而且——

lines.en: : It looks kind of like a dick, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 它看起来有点像老二，对吧？

lines.en: : Do they come in that size?
lines.zh: : 它们有那么大个的吗？

lines.en: : Boy do I have some videos I have to show you.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我手头有几个视频非给你看不可。

lines.en: : Tsubasa, come here. Touch my geoduck. I swear I’ll be quick.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa，过来。摸摸我的象拔蚌。我发誓我会很快的。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I should. My daughter is watching.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该不该。我女儿在看着呢。

lines.en: : Mom! Put down the fucking dick clam and cook something already! If you don’t win this round, we’re basically screwed!
lines.zh: : 妈！把那只该死的老二蚌放下，赶紧做点菜行不行！这轮你要是不赢，我们就基本完蛋了！

lines.en: : Hey, that doesn’t sound so bad.
lines.zh: : 嘿，听起来也不赖嘛。

lines.en: : MOM!
: Don’t yell at me, Makoto! I’m trying!
lines.zh: : 别冲我吼，Makoto！我在努力了！

lines.en: : You’re literally not!
lines.zh: : 你根本没有！

lines.en: scene momwar11
: What am I looking at here?
lines.zh: : 我这是在看着什么？

lines.en: : What I’ve prepared for you today is whole quail with a side of exotic, stir fried vegetables and a veal demi glace. Please enjoy to your heart’s content.
lines.zh: : 我今天为您准备的是整只鹌鹑，配上异国风味的清炒时蔬和小牛肉半釉酱。请尽情享用。

lines.en: : It looks like it was eaten already.
lines.zh: : 看起来像是已经被吃过了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that was me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是我吃的。

lines.en: : Maki, you can’t eat your opponent’s food! You’re not Tsubasa’s son!
lines.zh: : Maki，你不能吃对手的菜！你又不是 Tsubasa 的儿子！

lines.en: : To be fair, neither am-
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我也不——

lines.en: : YES YOU ARE, SENPAI! JUST ACCEPT IT!
lines.zh: : 你就是，前辈！认了吧！

lines.en: scene momwar12
: This is my fault. I offered the dish to Maki out of the kindness of my heart and assumed I would have enough time left over to make more.
lines.zh: : 这是我的错。我出于好心把那份菜让给了 Maki，还以为剩下的时间够我再做一份。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, that was not the case and I was left with nothing to offer but the remainder of her meal.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，事情并非如此，最后我只能拿出她那份菜剩下的部分。

lines.en: : Okay, so Tsubasa loses. But what about Maki? What did you make?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那 Tsubasa 输了。那 Maki 呢？你做了什么？

lines.en: : Sashimi.
lines.zh: : 生鱼片。

lines.en: : It’s just a whole fish.
lines.zh: : 就是一整条鱼。

lines.en: : Please enjoy to your heart’s content.
lines.zh: : 请尽情享用。

lines.en: : I have no idea how I’m supposed to cut it.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道该怎么切它。

lines.en: : What, and you think I do?
lines.zh: : 什么，你以为我就知道吗？

lines.en: : They’re always talking on those cooking shows about {i}deconstructed{/i} this and {i}deconstructed{/i} that. Just look at it as {i}reconstructed{/i} sashimi and call it a day.
lines.zh: : 那些烹饪节目里不是老在说什么{i}解构{/i}这个、{i}解构{/i}那个吗。你就把它当成「{i}重构版{/i}生鱼片」，就这么算了吧。

lines.en: scene momwar13
: They both lose.
lines.zh: : 她们两个都输。

lines.en: : If you didn’t say it, I was going to.
lines.zh: : 你要是不说，我也要说。

lines.en: scene black
: On to round two then!
lines.zh: : 那就进入第二轮吧！

lines.en: scene momwar14
: OOC, how are you?
lines.zh: : 出戏一下，你还好吗？

lines.en: : I thought you weren’t supposed to break character until after the costume contest was over?
lines.zh: : 我还以为要等变装比赛结束之后才可以出戏呢？

lines.en: : No one’s listening to us right now and I want to make sure you’re doing okay.
lines.zh: : 现在没人听我们说话，我想确认你还好不好。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没事。

lines.en: : We can leave now if you’re not comfortable, you know.
lines.zh: : 你要是不舒服，我们现在就可以走，你知道的。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking about it. I just also feel like that would draw too much attention to us and I like Sensei too much to hit him with an Irish goodbye.
lines.zh: : 我一直在考虑这个。不过我也觉得那样会让我们太引人注目，而且我太喜欢老师了，不想一声不吭就从他身边溜走。

lines.en: : I’m a little surprised you asked to tag along in the first place. I thought for sure you were going to go back to the hotel.
lines.zh: : 你一开始会要求跟来，我还挺意外的。我本来笃定你会回酒店的。

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize which contest this was.
lines.zh: : 我当时没反应过来这是哪场比赛。

lines.en: scene momwar15
Subject two, chosen by Touka, tests a mother’s ability to help her “child” with his or her homework.
lines.zh: 第二项题目由 Touka 选定，考验的是一位母亲辅导「孩子」做作业的能力。

lines.en: As such, I am joined by Maki on the floor of my living room- where I must pretend to have no idea what I’m talking about and lean on her for advice.
lines.zh: 于是，我和 Maki 一起坐在我家客厅的地板上——我必须装出一副一无所知的样子，然后靠她给我指导。

lines.en: There is no chance at all that this is going to end well.
lines.zh: 这件事绝对不可能善终。

lines.en: : I can’t watch. I’m going to be too disappointed.
lines.zh: : 我看不下去了。我会太失望的。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Makoto. If your mother is even a fraction as good of a teacher as you, I’m sure everything will be just fine.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Makoto。如果你母亲有你一半会教书，我相信一切都会没问题的。

lines.en: : So...whatcha need help with, Old Sport?
lines.zh: : 那么……需要帮忙吗，老伙计？

lines.en: : Please don’t call me “Old Sport.”
lines.zh: : 请不要叫我「老伙计」。

lines.en: : But that’s what I always call you. You’re “Old Sport” and I’m “Big Momma.” Now tell Big Momma what subject you need help with.
lines.zh: : 可我一直就是这么叫你的啊。你是「老伙计」，我是「大妈妈」。现在告诉大妈妈，你需要哪科的帮助。

lines.en: : Physics.
lines.zh: : 物理。

lines.en: : Jiggle physics?
lines.zh: : 抖动物理？

lines.en: : Regular physics.
lines.zh: : 普通的物理。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Have you tried Google?
lines.zh: : 你试过谷歌了吗？

lines.en: : The Internet is down.
lines.zh: : 网断了。

lines.en: : Want to watch a movie while we wait for it to come back up? I think I’ve got a few DVDs lying around that we can dust off.
lines.zh: : 要不要趁等网络恢复的时候看部电影？我记得家里还堆着几张 DVD，可以拿出来掸掸灰。

lines.en: : The power is out. All I can do right now is this physics homework.
lines.zh: : 停电了。我现在能做的就只有这份物理作业。

lines.en: : Have you tried asking your father?
lines.zh: : 你试过问你爸爸吗？

lines.en: : He’s dead.
lines.zh: : 他死了。

lines.en: : Can you wait until tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 你能等到明天吗？

lines.en: : It’s due tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 明天就要交。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Welp, Big Momma’s done all she can do, Old Sport. But she knows you’re a smart cookie and that you can handle this all on your own.
lines.zh: : 唉，大妈妈已经尽力了，老伙计。不过她知道你是个聪明孩子，这些你自己就能搞定。

lines.en: : My, your mother really {i}is{/i} useless in this department, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你母亲在这一块可{i}真是{/i}一点用都没有，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but at least she never called me “Old Sport.”
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过至少她从来没叫过我「老伙计」。

lines.en: scene black
scene momwar16
: ...and that’s everything there is to know about dark matter.
lines.zh: : ……而这就是关于暗物质你所需知道的一切。

lines.en: : I can’t take this anymore. Somebody slap me when it’s over.
lines.zh: : 我受不了了。等结束的时候谁来扇我一巴掌。

lines.en: : The concept of having a mother who is actually able to explain anything related to science is simply too much for me to comprehend.
lines.zh: : 有一个真的能讲解任何科学相关内容的母亲，这个概念对我来说实在太过超纲。

lines.en: : There’s a reason I chose this subject after all.
lines.zh: : 我选这个题目毕竟是有理由的。

lines.en: : Up until recently, I always struggled with the instructors that were chosen for me. Meaning that my mother would often step in and teach me instead.
lines.zh: : 直到不久之前，我一直在和他们为我挑选的老师们较劲。也就是说，我母亲常常会亲自上阵来教我。

lines.en: : She’s the smartest woman I know. Perhaps even smarter than Nodoka, and I often worry that Nodoka’s brain will swell to a size so large that it begins to seep out of her ears.
lines.zh: : 她是我认识的最聪明的女人。说不定比 Nodoka 还聪明——而我经常担心 Nodoka 的大脑会膨胀到开始从耳朵里渗出来。

lines.en: : I’ve decided I want your mom to win as well, Touka. But not because I like her. I want her to win because she’s never carried a box full of lube into my house.
lines.zh: : 我也决定希望你妈妈赢了，Touka。不过不是因为我喜欢她。我希望她赢，是因为她从来没有拎着一整箱润滑液进过我家。

lines.en: : Is that another middle class custom I’m not yet familiar with?
lines.zh: : 那又是我还不熟悉的中产阶级习俗吗？

lines.en: : No. Makoto’s mom is just a whore.
lines.zh: : 不是。Makoto 的妈妈就是个婊子。

lines.en: scene black
scene momwar17
Subject three, chosen by Makoto, is a Hail Mary of a topic choice that will either result in a crushing victory or the worst defeat possible for Maki.
lines.zh: 第三项题目由 Makoto 选定，这是个孤注一掷的题目，对 Maki 来说要么带来压倒性的胜利，要么带来最惨的失败。

lines.en: It is also one of the most uncomfortable situations I have ever been in considering everyone has filtered into my room to watch me receive “the talk.”
lines.zh: 考虑到所有人都涌进我的房间，等着看我接受「那场谈话」，这也是我经历过的最不自在的场景之一。

lines.en: : My dearest Son...you’ve probably noticed by now that your body is undergoing certain...changes.
lines.zh: : 我亲爱的儿子……你现在大概已经注意到了，你的身体正在经历某些……变化。

lines.en: : You’re likely feeling things you’ve never felt before. Becoming interested in girls when, just last year, you were talking about how “icky” they were.
lines.zh: : 你大概正感受着一些从未感受过的东西。开始对女孩子产生兴趣，而就在去年，你还在说她们有多「恶心」。

lines.en: : But that’s fine. In fact, it’s completely normal.
lines.zh: : 但那没关系。事实上，那完全正常。

lines.en: : I hate this.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌这个。

lines.en: : Yeah, this is weird as fuck. Not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这他妈的太怪了。说真的。

lines.en: : You see, there comes a time in {i}everyone’s{/i} life like that...Where we begin to become more conscious of the opposite sex...and the ways we feel about them.
lines.zh: : 你看，{i}每个人{/i}的人生中都会有这样的时候……我们开始更加在意异性……以及我们对她们的感受。

lines.en: : Which is why it’s important for me to tell you about this {i}now{/i} before you wind up having questions further down the line.
lines.zh: : 所以我{i}现在{/i}把这些告诉你很重要，免得你以后攒下一堆问题。

lines.en: : Boys and girls...are structurally different from one another. It’s one of the many beauties of life.
lines.zh: : 男孩和女孩……在结构上是不一样的。那是生命众多美妙之处中的一个。

lines.en: : And what you’re experiencing right now is your body...activating. Preparing to one day create children of your own so the family name can live on.
lines.zh: : 而你现在正在经历的，是你的身体……启动了。它在为有朝一日孕育你自己的孩子做准备，好让家族的姓氏延续下去。

lines.en: : Do you know how that works, Son? How babies are made?
lines.zh: : 你知道那是怎么运作的吗，儿子？宝宝是怎么来的？

lines.en: : Son?
lines.zh: : 儿子？

lines.en: : No...please tell me...
lines.zh: : 不……请告诉我……

lines.en: scene momwar18
: Have we reached a good stopping point? Even if it’s for the competition, I feel quite strange explaining the process of sexual intercourse to an adult male.
lines.zh: : 我们是不是到了一个合适的停下来的地方？就算是为了比赛，向一个成年男性讲解性交的过程，我还是觉得相当别扭。

lines.en: : And I feel incredibly emasculated.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得自己被极度地阉割了。

lines.en: : Aww! But we were just getting to the good part!
lines.zh: : 哎呀！可我们才刚要到精彩的部分！

lines.en: : You can do whatever you’d like with the “good part,” Maki. I simply feel a little...strange about this and am confident in my performance up until now.
lines.zh: : 那个「精彩的部分」你想怎么处理都行，Maki。我只是对这件事感觉有点……别扭，而且我到目前为止的表现我还是有信心的。

lines.en: : Fine, fine, fine. Step aside. I got this.
lines.zh: : 行，行，行。让开。这个我来。

lines.en: scene black
: Sit back...relax...and watch how it’s done, y’all.
lines.zh: : 坐好……放松……看着我是怎么做的，各位。

lines.en: scene momwar19
: Hey again, Old Sport. Just wanted to pop in and talk to you for a little while about the changes your body is going through and why it’s normal to be confused at a time like this.
lines.zh: : 又见面了，老伙计。我只是想过来和你聊一会儿，说说你身体正在经历的变化，还有为什么在这种时候感到困惑是正常的。

lines.en: : I understand just how overwhelming all of these new feelings must be for you because I was the same exact way back when I was your age.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚所有这些新感受对你来说有多么不知所措，因为我在你这个年纪的时候也是一模一样的。

lines.en: : But you don’t have to worry, because I’ll tell you everything you need to know and answer {i}any{/i} questions that you might have about the wonders that are puberty and sex.
lines.zh: : 不过你不用担心，因为我会把你需要知道的一切都告诉你，也会回答你关于青春期和性这些奇妙事物的{i}任何{/i}问题。

lines.en: scene momwar20
: I’ve even brought visual aids so I can show you firsthand how everything works!
lines.zh: : 我甚至还带了视觉教具，好让你亲眼看看一切是怎么运作的！

lines.en: : Oh my lord.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪。

lines.en: : Oh my {i}lord.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我的{i}天哪。{/i}

lines.en: : There must be some sort of rule against this, correct? There is no way that unsheathing such...vulgar items in front of one’s child is acceptable.
lines.zh: : 这种事总该有条规则禁止吧，对吗？在自己孩子面前亮出这种……粗俗的物件，怎么可能被允许。

lines.en: : I think that’s up to Sensei to decide. Also, {i}dayum that thing is thick.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得这得由老师来决定。还有，{i}哇哦，那东西可真粗。{/i}

lines.en: : One thing to know when dealing with Sensei is that the most perverted option practically always wins.
lines.zh: : 和老师打交道有一点要知道——最变态的那个选项，几乎总是会赢。

lines.en: : Yeah, Maki takes this round. And since Tsubasa won the last one, that means we’re tied at one win a piece.
lines.zh: : 行，这一轮 Maki 拿下。而 Tsubasa 赢了上一轮，也就是说我们一比一打平。

lines.en: : So...do both floors get a point now? Or is there going to be some sort of tiebreaker round?
lines.zh: : 那么……现在两个楼层各得一分吗？还是说会有某种加赛？

lines.en: : Should I make more coffee?
lines.zh: : 我要不要再煮点咖啡？

lines.en: : Nah, that’s enough MILF energy for one day. Let’s just clear out of here and make Sensei choose a winner. That seems like the easiest solution to all of this.
lines.zh: : 不了，一天的 MILF 能量已经够了。我们赶紧撤吧，让老师来选一个赢家。这似乎是解决这一切最简单的办法。

lines.en: : {i}Pick me and you can keep the onahole.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}选我，那个飞机杯就归你了。{/i}

lines.en: : I heard that, Mrs. Miyamura. And bribery will not be tolerated.
lines.zh: : 我听到了，Miyamura 夫人。而且贿赂是不被允许的。

lines.en: : Bribery will probably be tolerated.
lines.zh: : 贿赂大概是会被允许的。

lines.en: : I told you, Touka. The perverted option always wins.
lines.zh: : 我说了吧，Touka。最变态的那个选项总是会赢。

lines.en: scene black
scene momwar21
: Well...it was a hard fought battle. And if there’s anything I learned today, it’s that motherhood is no easy task.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这是一场苦战。如果说今天我学到了什么，那就是当母亲绝不是件轻松的事。

lines.en: : But for every child out there who needs someone to relate to-
lines.zh: : 但对于每一个需要有人理解的孩子来说——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Just choose a fucking winner so we can get out of here and sleep.
lines.zh: : 巴拉巴拉巴拉。赶紧选一个他妈的赢家，好让我们离开这儿去睡觉。

lines.en: : Fine. But only because I am also tired.
lines.zh: : 行。不过只是因为我也累了。

lines.en: : The winner of tonight’s...mom contest thing is...
lines.zh: : 今晚这场……妈妈比赛什么玩意儿的获胜者是……

lines.en: menu:
Maki
lines.zh: Maki

lines.en: : Maki.
lines.zh: : Maki。

lines.en: scene momwar22
$ makimomwin = True
$ dorm1war2points += 1
: Hah...see, Mom? I told you that-
lines.zh: : 哈……看吧，妈妈？我就说——

lines.en: scene momwar23
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Yes, what?!
lines.zh: : 对啊，什么？！

lines.en: : How did my mother lose when her competition brought out sex toys and sabotaged her quail?! This is-
lines.zh: : 我母亲怎么可能输？她的对手可是掏出了性玩具，还把她的鹌鹑给毁了！？这简直——

lines.en: : Touka, dear. There will be times in our lives where we will lose. And when those times come, we must lose with grace.
lines.zh: : Touka，亲爱的。人生中总会有输的时候。而当那些时刻到来时，我们必须优雅地输。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Enough. There will be other contests.
lines.zh: : 够了。以后还有别的比赛。

lines.en: : I won?!
lines.zh: : 我赢了？！

lines.en: : I mom’ed?!
lines.zh: : 我当妈成功了？！

lines.en: : Was...the onahole really all it took?
lines.zh: : 难道……真的只要有飞机杯就够了？

lines.en: : That wasn’t it.
lines.zh: : 不是因为那个。

lines.en: : Tsubasa did great and was probably the more {i}conventional{/i} mother. I just liked Maki’s informal approach to parenting a little more.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 表现很好，而且大概是更{i}传统{/i}的那种母亲。我只是更喜欢 Maki 那种不那么拘束的育儿方式。

lines.en: : This is, like...the fifth best thing that has ever happened to me!
lines.zh: : 这大概是……有史以来发生在我身上第五好的事情！

lines.en: : Well, now I’m just curious to know the other four.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我现在倒好奇另外四件是什么了。

lines.en: scene black
: But unfortunately, we don’t have time for that! The victory for the first floor has been added to my official Dorm Wars notebook and we are now free to leave!
lines.zh: : 但遗憾的是，我们没时间聊那个了！一楼的胜利已经记进我的官方宿舍大战笔记本，现在我们可以走了！

lines.en: Tsubasa
lines.zh: Tsubasa

lines.en: : Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene momwar24
$ tsubasamomwin = True
$ dorm2war2points += 1
: Wow. What a crazy turn of events.
lines.zh: : 哇。这剧情转折也太疯狂了。

lines.en: : Yeah...kind of saw that coming. But I {i}did{/i} accidentally get my hopes up a little, so...
lines.zh: : 是啊……我多少也料到了。不过我{i}还是{/i}不小心抱了点期待，所以……

lines.en: : Congrats, Tsubasa. You’re the better mom.
lines.zh: : 恭喜，Tsubasa。你是更好的妈妈。

lines.en: : You did it, Mother! You have once again proven your worth against someone significantly less qualified than you! I have never been more proud!
lines.zh: : 您做到了，母亲！您又一次证明了自己比那个远远不如您的人更有价值！我从未如此骄傲！

lines.en: : While I’m humbled by your decision, I would like to add that my rival in today’s contest did an exceptional job as well.
lines.zh: : 您的决定让我受宠若惊，不过我想补充一句，今天比赛里我的对手表现得同样出色。

lines.en: scene momwar25
: Maki, you were a worthy adversary and I applaud both your resolve and determination.
lines.zh: : Maki，你是一位配得上我的对手，我为你那份决心和毅力鼓掌。

lines.en: : I would also appreciate the opportunity to...umm...
lines.zh: : 另外，如果有机会的话，我也想……嗯……

lines.en: : How should I put this?...
lines.zh: : 该怎么说呢？……

lines.en: : Check out the haul in the trunk of my car?
lines.zh: : 参观一下我车后备箱里的那批货？

lines.en: : If you’d be so kind, yes.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，是的。

lines.en: : Mother?
lines.zh: : 母亲？

lines.en: scene black
: Mother, where are you going?
lines.zh: : 母亲，您要去哪儿？

lines.en: : I’ll be right back, dear. Please stay in the house for a moment. I don’t want your pride in me to be reduced to nothing in the blink of an eye.
lines.zh: : 我马上就回来，亲爱的。请在屋里待一会儿。我可不想你对我的骄傲在眨眼之间化为乌有。

lines.en: : Alright! With Tsubasa’s victory, the second floor has gained another tally in my official Dorm Wars notebook and we are now free to leave!
lines.zh: : 好了！随着 Tsubasa 的胜利，二楼在我的官方宿舍大战笔记本上又添了一笔，现在我们可以走了！

lines.en: : Either head back to your dorms or take a ride in the complimentary shuttle to our hotel room provided to us by the wonderful and {i}extremely{/i} affluent Tsukioka family!
lines.zh: : 你们可以回宿舍，也可以搭乘由美好又{i}极其{/i}富有的 Tsukioka 家为我们提供的免费班车，去我们的酒店房间！

lines.en: : Or...I don’t know! Crash here if your name is Sensei or you’re lazy or something.
lines.zh: : 或者……我不知道！如果你叫老师，或者你懒得动什么的，就在这儿凑合一晚。

lines.en: : Great idea, Imani. I think I’ll do just that.
lines.zh: : 好主意，Imani。我想我就这么办。

lines.en: : Absolutely not! No!
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！不行！

lines.en: scene momwar26
: No?
lines.zh: : 不行？

lines.en: : Yeah!
: Is it yeah or no? I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 到底是行还是不行？我糊涂了。

lines.en: : Yeah, no!
lines.zh: : 对，不行！

lines.en: : That didn’t help.
lines.zh: : 这没有帮助。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is that you have to come to the hotel because that’s where I’m sleeping and you have to sleep in the same building as me!
lines.zh: : 我想说的是你必须来酒店，因为我要睡在那儿，而你必须和我睡在同一栋楼里！

lines.en: : The red one speaks the truth. Like an arrow, she has one path. A path that you, too...are destined to walk.
lines.zh: : 红发那位说的是实话。她就像一支箭，只有一条路。而那条路……你也注定要走。

lines.en: : Where did you get those shuriken?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿弄来的那些手里剑？

lines.en: : I found them.
lines.zh: : 我捡到的。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : 老师！

lines.en: : Fine, Jesus. I’ll go back to the hotel. It just seems like a waste when my bed is like twenty feet away.
lines.zh: : 行了，老天。我回酒店就是了。只是我的床就在大概二十英尺开外，感觉有点浪费。

lines.en: scene black
: Hm? Senpai? You’re coming back to the hotel with us? I could have sworn you were going to stay behind.
lines.zh: : 嗯？前辈？你要跟我们一起回酒店？我还敢发誓你会留下来呢。

lines.en: : That’s not a problem, is it? Because I don’t think I’m allowed to stay behind anymore.
lines.zh: : 这没什么问题吧？因为我觉得我已经不被允许留下来了。

lines.en: : Uhh...no! Of course not. It’s totally fine. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 呃……没有！当然没有。完全没问题。只是……

lines.en: : Ahh, fuck it. You’ll find out when we get there.
lines.zh: : 啊，管他呢。你到了就知道了。
